label: prf:skein-generation
title: Proof of Skein generation
html:
Spanning. Fix a diagram of L with base points on each component and order the crossings. Changing a crossing replaces L_\pm by L_\mp at the cost of a multiple of L_0, which has one fewer crossing; after finitely many changes the diagram is a stack of unknotted, unlinked components (a descending diagram), which is an unlink. Induction on the number of crossings, then on the number of crossings that must be changed, writes [L] as an R-combination of unlinks. For the unlink of c components, apply the relation to a one-crossing kink of one component: L_+ = L_- = the unlink of c components and L_0 is the unlink of c + 1 components, so (a - a^{-1})\,[U^{\sqcup c}] = (q - q^{-1})\,[U^{\sqcup (c+1)}], hence [U^{\sqcup (c+1)}] = \tfrac{a - a^{-1}}{q - q^{-1}}\,[U^{\sqcup c}] in R. So [U] spans.

Freeness. The HOMFLYPT polynomial exists as an isotopy invariant satisfying the relation with P_U = 1 [lickorish1997], so [L] \mapsto P_L is a well-defined R-linear map \mathrm{Sk}(S^3) \to R sending [U] to 1. Hence [U] is not torsion and \mathrm{Sk}(S^3) = R\,[U] is free of rank one, with [L] = P_L [U]. \square
